note: Full real multi-view dataset placements. Brian places these on the board before the capture run. Base-centre is the square centre unless overridden.

guidance.spread: Six different squares across the centre/left/right of the board; avoid a8/h8 far corners (near the reach limit).
guidance.centering: Place each piece roughly at the square centre; small offsets are fine and useful (the model learns in-square position).
guidance.orientation: For the knight, note its facing direction if easy to see; other pieces are symmetric.
guidance.one_piece_per_square: Keep the six chosen squares free of other pieces so the base-centre label is unambiguous.
guidance.arm_clearance: Leave e5 and the camera's approach area clear of your hands when the capture runs.
